title: Blinkit Brings GTA 6 To 11 Cities Ahead Of Launch
summary: Blinkit begins delivering Grand Theft Auto 6 download codes across 11 cities
detailed: Blinkit started delivering boxed download codes for the PlayStation 5 edition of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) in select areas across 11 Indian cities.
The quick commerce platform priced the PS5 Standard Edition at ₹5,999, matching the PlayStation Store price ahead of the global launch.
Blinkit (owned by Eternal) and CEO Albinder Dhindsa are the primary actors involved.
This matters because it demonstrates the expansion of quick commerce into high-profile digital-physical hybrid product deliveries within minutes, scaling past groceries into high-margin categories.
sentences: Blinkit has started delivering boxed download codes for the PlayStation 5 (PS5) edition of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) in select areas across 11 Indian cities.
The rollout ties Blinkit’s push to sell more than groceries to a major gaming launch, with the PS5 Standard Edition priced at the same ₹5,999 as on the PlayStation Store.
Customers can redeem the code and download the game before it unlocks tomorrow.
Blinkit plans to add more cities by then.

Eternal-owned quick commerce platform Blinkit has started delivering download codes for Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6), the latest instalment in Rockstar Games’ open-world action-adventure series, in select areas across 11 Indian cities, a day ahead of the game’s global release tomorrow.
The development was announced by CEO Albinder Dhindsa today, as the Eternal-owned platform looks to tap into demand around the launch.
“It took 13 years for GTA 6 to be released.
In the meantime, we built Blinkit so that you can get the game delivered in minutes,” he said.
GTA 6 is currently available on Blinkit in select areas of Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Noida, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, Kolkata, and Ahmedabad.
The company plans to expand availability to more cities between November 18 and 19, Dhindsa added.
The deliveries will see customers receive a physical box containing a digital download code for the game, rather than a traditional game disc.
Buyers can redeem the code through the PlayStation Store and download the game before it unlocks in India at midnight tonight.
Rockstar Games is releasing GTA 6 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, while Blinkit’s listing is for PS5.
The quick commerce platform is offering the PS5 Standard Edition of GTA 6 for ₹5,999.
Blinkit has increasingly used unconventional launches and quirky campaigns to stretch the idea of what a quick commerce platform can deliver.

In January 2025, the company launched a 10-minute ambulance service in parts of Gurugram, initially deploying five ambulances equipped with oxygen cylinders, defibrillators, emergency medicines and paramedics.
It also ventured into document services, allowing users to order printouts and passport-size photographs through the app.
Blinkit also launched a ‘Scream for Ice Cream’ challenge, allowing users to scream into their phones to unlock discounts on ice cream brands.
The campaign turned a routine purchase into a social media-driven activity.
These launches help Blinkit stand out in the increasingly crowded quick commerce market, where it competes with Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart Minutes, Amazon Now and BigBasket.

India’s quick commerce market is projected to reach $40 Bn by 2030, driven by hyperlocal fulfillment (typically under 10-30 minutes) through dark stores and rapid expansion beyond groceries into higher-margin categories, as per Swiggy CEO Sriharsha Majety.
In Q2 FY27, Blinkit’s net order value rose 79.3% YoY to ₹20,940 Cr, while revenue grew 93.6% YoY to ₹19,152 Cr.
The business posted an adjusted EBITDA profit of ₹184 Cr against a loss of ₹156 Cr a year earlier.
Blinkit added 308 dark stores on a net basis during the quarter, taking its network to 2,751.
Eternal expects the count to cross 3,500 by March 2027 and reach about 5,000 by March 2028.
